newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Feb new motor vehicle sales rise 5.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Feb new motor vehicle sales rise 5.1 pct.

text.p: New motor vehicle sales rose 5.1 percent seasonally adjusted in February to 111,377 units from a revised 105,975 (112,520) units in January, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a 3.1 percent rise in February.
The rise in new vehicle sales in February nearly reversed the revised 5.8 percent decline in January, Statistics Canada said.
The agency said early indications of March sales released by the auto industry suggest a month-to-month gain in both cars and trucks.
But truck sales remained highly volatile in February, Statscan said. Sales jumped 8.3 percent after an 11.3 percent decline in January.
Car sales rose 2.4 percent from January, with the gain coming almost entirely from sales of cars built overseas.
